steps.instruction: Melt 5 teaspoons of unsalted butter in a pot over medium-low heat.
Once the butter is fully melted, stir in 5 teaspoons of flour.
Keep stirring on medium-low heat until golden and nutty-smelling.
steps.spoken: Keep stirring the flour and butter on medium-low heat until it is lightly golden brown and starts to smell a bit nutty.

steps.instruction: Stir in about 1 cup of the milk until combined.
Repeat with more milk until the sauce is thick.
steps.spoken: Keep adding milk, a cup at a time, until you have a thick sauce and new milk mixes in easily. Never stop stirring.

steps.instruction: Stir in the rest of the milk.
Lower the heat to low and keep stirring.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat to low and keep stirring. Get into the corners of the pot, because the sauce burns easily.

steps.instruction: When the sauce is as thick as you like, add salt and pepper to taste.
Add a pinch of nutmeg, freshly grated if you can.
